items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: see when we left here we had a booking from here to Oklahoma City... coming back this was with Salstam?

ctx.x: see when we left here we had a booking from here to Oklahoma City from Oklahoma City to Albuquerque New Mexico from Albuquerque New Mexico to Las Vegas then we jumped from Las Vegas to Los Angeles and from Los Angeles to Frisco from Frisco to Oakland and coming back this was with Salstam?
